bullets.text: The State government ordered civic agencies to complete flood mitigation work in Chennai and suburbs by October 15, which the office should monitor.
Residents staged a midnight road roko in Vadaperumbakkam near Red Hills protesting power cuts, prompting the office to track utility reliability.
Locals expressed anguish as trains still bypass the completed Adambakkam railway station, and the office should watch for operational updates.
Bill Gates warned that AI could risk one billion lives, which the portfolio team should note alongside ongoing tech policy discussions.
TANGEDCO announced a five-hour power shutdown on September 30 affecting Velachery and other areas, so the constituency team must watch for service disruptions.
Velachery-Tambaram high road traffic slowed significantly due to sewerage work and damaged roads, requiring the office to coordinate traffic relief.
Passengers in Adambakkam are aggrieved as local rail services remain non-operational despite station readiness, which the office should review.
A village administrative officer and his assistant were arrested in Avadi for taking an eight thousand rupee bribe, prompting anti-corruption watch.
Public arguments broke out in Thiruninravur when water resources officials removed encroachments from the big lake, requiring local administrative oversight.
Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu expressed concern over poor road infrastructure at the Ambattur industrial estate, which the district team should address.
TIDCO has invited tenders for a four hundred crore rupee digital finance hub in Coimbatore to promote FinTech, which the digital team must track.
Starbucks is establishing its first Indian Global Capability Centre in Chennai creating 800 jobs, marking a major win for the IT portfolio.
Omnicom Group launched a new Global Capability Centre in Coimbatore, highlighting Tamil Nadu growth in Tier-two tech hubs for the portfolio team.
The Madras High Court adjourned hearings on a DMK suit seeking to restrain ministers and TVK IT wing from linking them in a defamation case.
The TVK government rolled back several controversial initial announcements after public pushback, which the political team should monitor closely.
Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay will share the stage with Prime Minister Narendra Modi on October 11 to inaugurate Chennai Metro Phase Two.
A new scheme was launched to provide gold rings to newborns in Chennai government hospitals, which the office should track for implementation.
Fare details and station schedules were released for the Poonamallee to Vadapalani metro stretch opening soon, requiring public awareness support.
